nodes.text: herself, then she shall go into the bishop's household,
and he who seduces her, he is an outlaw,
and the bishop shall have his property. On sacrifice to heathen
the man who heeds that and gives house-room to that man
for it, he is as much an outlaw as
a manslayer, and the bishop owns every penny
of his property. And if [he] denies it, a man shall carry
the iron for it, and a woman reach into the kettle. And
he who charges people with these matters, then he becomes
